description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'sgd_log' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer + SGD classifier (log loss).
model: sgd_log (TF-IDF word featurizer + SGD classifier (log loss))
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'sgd_log', group(s): linear, online); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
